notes:
Two dead entries removed from the clip tools, and a new self-check that keeps the app honest.

The Look and Speed entries in the editor's clip-tool table pointed at controls that were not in the app any more — nothing could reach them, but they were one added button away from a crash. Look and Speed live on as per-clip settings, which is the better design anyway. Alongside them: a new sweep that takes every value the app can offer you and puts it through the code that would reject it, so a menu can never drift away from what the engine accepts.
